Devon (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock the 'Observe Lite' scope for the sprint. Customers keep asking for cost visibility + trace correlation. Thinking minimal: dashboard (per-route cost + p50/p95 latency), tracing hook to attach our request_id -> model shard/timestamp, and an error-summary widget with top 5 error messages. Agree?
Anu (Eng): I like the minimal list. Question: do we do full traces or sampling? full traces are expensive.
Lina (SRE): Sampling makes sense for 90% of traffic. But for customer debugging we need a way to force full trace for a request_id.
Mike (Product): +1. Product ask: must include a toggle in the console to enable full-trace for a workspace for N minutes. Also need RBAC guard.
Tara (Research): From evals, rare model hangs are root caused by large KV cache hits — full traces helped. If we sample only, include a path to retroactively pull logs for specific request_ids (if retained).
Anu (Eng): Implementation sketch: 1) prefix-based sampling (1% baseline), 2) allow console-triggered capture via an API: POST /internal/trace-capture {request_id, duration}. 3) small dashboard surface that reads aggregated metrics from metrics pipeline.
Devon (PM): OK. Acceptance criteria for launch (proposed): - Dashboard: per-route cost + latency, filter by timeframe - Trace hook: console button to capture full traces for a workspace/req-id - Error widget: top 5 error classes + quick link to traces - Docs + short how-to + security checklist.
Lina (SRE): Add: SLA for retention of captured traces (default 7 days), and auto-expire. Also column-level masking for any user payloads in traces.
Mike (Product): Customers (enterprise) requested cost echo back to billing lines (e.g., per-org cost breakout). Can we add a small CSV export on day 1?
Anu (Eng): CSV export is trivial if we have per-route metrics in telemetry store. We'll include export of the last 30 days.
Tara (Research): Add a regression alert: when error rate for a route increases > 3x baseline AND p95 latency increases > 2x, trigger a diagnostic run and tag top prompts for eval.
Devon (PM): Nice. Prioritization: what's the minimal dev effort for a ship-ready MVP? Estimate please.
Anu (Eng): Rough T-shirt: dashboard UI + metrics queries = 3 dev-weeks. Sampling + capture API + retention = 3 dev-weeks. Export + RBAC + console button = 1.5 dev-weeks. Total ~7.5 dev-weeks (single engineer). Recommend split across two engineers for 4 weeks.
Lina (SRE): Ops tasks: retention TTL, S3 export policy, and an emergency off switch = 1 week of SRE involvement during rollout.
Mike (Product): Risks: cost blowup if capture is misused. Need default quota and quota enforcement. Also legal/compliance sign-off for trace payloads.
Devon (PM): Action items: - Anu: draft API spec for capture and sampling controls by EOW - Lina: retention/ops runbook + emergency off switch - Mike: write product brief with RBAC/quotas and customer-facing text - Tara: define regression alert thresholds and eval hooks
Anu (Eng): I'll post a proto spec in #eng-observability later today.
deploy-bot: Deployment queued: observability-metrics-api v0.12.3 -> staging (build 4872) <https://ci.internal/redwood/4872|view build>
Devon (PM): Nice. Final question — launch criteria gating: do we require CSV export day 1 or can that be day+1?
Mike (Product): Make it day+1. Shipping the toggle and trace capture + dashboard is the real customer-facing win. CSV can follow.
Lina (SRE): Agreed. Also require emergency off switch present before any public rollout.
Devon (PM): OK locked. I'll update the roadmap doc and drop the ticket list into the sprint board. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
